what: T7's hunt: festival night (demo/src/rehearsal/domain/festival.ts) on the fixed code, a million seeds across both network modes and five fault mixes, every 1,000th seed run twice and its histories compared. failing counts seeds with a violation of each invariant; expected counts seeds whose only overlaps were past the lease's margin (decision 0029); fenced counts the appends the journal's sequence check refused because another writer had got there first (decision 0013), the seeds they were in, and how many of those seeds paused a node. bugs lists every bug the hunt found on the way, each with the shrunk plan of the run that showed it, which test/demo/found.test.ts replays
machine: Apple M5 Pro, darwin 25.4.0, 17 worker processes

bugs.name: split brain
bugs.what: When a partition cut both ways, each side downed the other, and the halves never merged
bugs.fix: Keep the majority: only a side with more than half the members downs the rest, and a smaller side downs itself and rejoins

bugs.name: a lone first seed
bugs.what: A node that downed itself restarted while the partition held and, as the first seed, formed a cluster of its own that nothing ever merged
bugs.fix: A member keeps greeting the seeds it has no live member at, so two clusters formed apart merge once they can reach each other

bugs.name: a lost hello
bugs.what: A dial across a partition had its open held and its hello lost, so the connection opened with no hello and remoting waited on it for good
bugs.fix: A connection without a hello after 5 s is closed, and dialed again

bugs.name: a lease renewed for good
bugs.what: The store renews every lease it has as a holder’s, so a lease whose release failed was renewed for good, and no other node could take its shard
bugs.fix: A lease the store renews that the holder doesn’t hold is given back

bugs.name: a leave cut short
bugs.what: A leaving node stopped heartbeating, so a handoff longer than downing took got it downed halfway
bugs.fix: A leaving node heartbeats and gossips until it has left

bugs.name: a leave that never ends
bugs.what: A shard that lost its lease in a database hang was still stopping when its node began to leave, and its stop never told the region it was done, so the node stayed leaving for good
bugs.fix: A leaving region checks whether it’s done whenever a shard stops, and waits for its acquires to be answered, handing on a shard granted after the leave began

bugs.name: a message overtaken
bugs.what: A lookup for one shard named another’s holder while messages for that one still waited, so the next message went straight there and overtook them
bugs.fix: A region never routes a message past messages already waiting for its shard

bugs.name: an address never dialed
bugs.what: A node learned of an incarnation it had never connected to only as down, marked its address down, and never dialed it again, while the new incarnation there waited to be dialed
bugs.fix: Membership’s frames dial an address even while an old incarnation there is down; the hello says which uid answers

bugs.name: a newcomer counted twice
bugs.what: A member let a newcomer in during a partition, so its side counted one more member than the far side knew of, and both sides thought they were the larger
bugs.fix: A node that can’t reach every member lets no one new in, and greets no missing seed, until it can

bugs.name: a lease given back twice
bugs.what: The first fix for a lease renewed for good raced the region: it learned the token and sent its release, the region’s own acquire got the same token back first, and the release freed a lease the region held, so another node ran the shard alongside it
bugs.fix: An acquire waits for a give-back of the same lease to finish

bugs.name: a side of one
bugs.what: The crowd knew only node-1 when a partition cut it off, won the tie on its address, and downed node-1 for good
bugs.fix: A side of one never keeps the cluster, unless that node is the only seed

bugs.name: two sides that downed each other
bugs.what: A partition came while a join was still spreading, so the two sides counted different members, each thought it the larger, and each downed the other
bugs.fix: Two nodes that downed each other settle it at their hello: the smaller side gives way and rejoins

bugs.name: a join never finished
bugs.what: A node was let in, but a one-way partition lost its welcome, and it was downed before it heard; still joining, it ignored being told so, and tried to join as a downed uid for good
bugs.fix: A joining node told its uid is down gives up, and comes back as a new one

bugs.name: a bounced message overtaken
bugs.what: A message sent to a stale holder came back to a region already holding a later message for the shard, rejoined the queue behind it, and was delivered second
bugs.fix: A message that comes back goes in ahead of everything that never left the queue, after anything that came back before it

bugs.name: a reply dropped at a down address
bugs.what: A node that restarted learned the crowd’s old incarnation only as removed, marked the crowd’s address down, and dropped its replies to the crowd’s new incarnation as unreachable
bugs.fix: A message for another incarnation than the one downed at its address waits for a connection, and dials, instead of being dropped

bugs.name: two clusters that never met
bugs.what: node-1 gave way to a cluster that had downed it and rejoined node-2, which had downed the other cluster too, but that cluster had never heard of either new incarnation, so neither side counted the other and they never merged
bugs.fix: Two nodes are in different clusters whenever one has the other down and the other doesn’t count it a member, and the smaller side gives way; ties go to the side with the earlier seed

bugs.name: a lease given back too soon
bugs.what: A lease lost at its deadline while its show was still persisting a sale on a slow disk was given back at once; another node took the show and recovered before the sale landed, and answered a read from before it
bugs.fix: A lease is given back only a TTL after its holder let it go, as the store would have kept it had its renewals stopped

bugs.name: a release that landed late
bugs.what: A node handed a shard off on a slow disk and, alone in a partition, took it straight back; its acquire landed before its release and kept the token, then the release freed the lease it had just taken, and another node ran the show alongside it
bugs.fix: An acquire waits for a release of the same lease still on its way

bugs.name: a leaving node that never stopped asking
bugs.what: A leaving node stopped checking who it could hear, so it went on asking a node that had downed itself to take its last shard, never finished leaving, and as the first seed let no one back in
bugs.fix: A leaving node still marks members unreachable, though it downs no one

bugs.name: a show forgotten after an error
bugs.what: A write recording a show as remembered failed on a database error and was only logged, so when its node was killed, its shard started elsewhere without it, and the one ask for it had gone to the dead node
bugs.fix: A remember that fails is tried again, with backoff, while its entity runs

rehearsalBugs.name: jumps judged one at a time
rehearsalBugs.what: pastTheMargin judged each jump of the database's clock alone, so two jumps 86 ms apart, each inside the 1,000 ms margin, outran it together, and the overlap they allowed was reported as a violation instead of as expected
rehearsalBugs.fix: Jumps within one TTL add up, with the most a node can drift over it

rehearsalBugs.name: a kill in a settling cluster
rehearsalBugs.what: failoverWithin checked a kill 3 ms after a partition ended, while two nodes it had made restart were still rejoining, and blamed failover for the time they took
rehearsalBugs.fix: A fault that ended within a bound before a kill counts as near it, as one under way in the bound after it does
